name: Retelling of a Story: Cinderella
source:
Your uncle has built a machine that allows people to enter fairy tales, but he needs your help to make it work. When you step inside, you find yourself in the world of Cinderella – but there’s a twist: you’re the prince, and the royal ball is only a week away. 

Now you must learn how to be Prince Charming and make it in time to sweep Cinderella off her feet.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=16478]lemmasoft[/url]]
translation:
你的叔叔建造了一台机器，可以让人们进入童话故事，但他需要你的帮助才能让它发挥作用。当你走进去时，你会发现自己身处灰姑娘的世界 - 但有一个转折：你是王子，距离皇家舞会只有一周了。

现在你必须学习如何成为白马王子并及时让灰姑娘为之倾倒。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=16478]lemmasoft[/url]]
